HP 24 inch All-in-One Desktop PC AMD  (Modric DF)
Phoebe Lee, Jodi Payne, Maria Nemi, Laura Morris

Value-first reliability. Engineered for essential everyday needs.
This audience prioritizes value above all, demanding dependable performance at an affordable price. Their computing needs are straightforward—browsing, email, streaming, video calls, and basic productivity—and they have little interest in advanced performance or premium features they won’t use. Simplicity and ease of use are non-negotiable; they expect devices that set up quickly, run smoothly, and require minimal effort to maintain. Design is appreciated but not decisive—the real driver is a practical, reliable device that gets the job done without unnecessary extras or added cost.
